card.statement:
Let $\lambda\in {\mathfrak h}^*$.

- [(i)] A sequence $(\mu_i)_ {i \in J}$ is $\lambda$-connected (or, simply, connected) if $g_{\lambda}(\mu_i, \mu_{i+1})=0$ for all $i \in J$, for some connected subset $J$ of $\mathbb{Z}$. A subsequence $(\mu_{j'})_{j'\in  J'}$ of a connected sequence $(\mu_j)_{j\in  J}$ will be called a connected subsequence if $J'$ is connected.

- [(ii)] A $\lambda$-connected sequence $(\mu_j)_{j\in  J}$ with $\mu_i\neq\mu_j$ for any $i\neq j$, is called $\lambda$-connected chain.

- [(iii)] We will say that a set $B$ is $\lambda$-connected if the elements of $B$ can be ordered in a $\lambda$-connected chain $(\mu_j)_{j\in  J}$. We will call the sequence $(\mu_j)_{j\in  J}$ the $\lambda$-connected chain associated to $B$.
card.label: Definition 52

paper.title: Classification of simple Gelfand-Tsetlin modules of $\displaystyle \mathfrak{sl}(3)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and an explicit realization of all irreducible Gelfand-Tsetlin modules of the complex Lie algebra sl(3). The realization of these modules uses regular and derivative Gelfand-Tsetlin tableaux. In particular, we list all simple Gelfand-Tsetlin sl(3)-modules with infinite-dimensional weight spaces. Also, we express all simple Gelfand-Tsetlin sl(3)-modules as subquotionets of localized Gelfand-Tsetlin E_{21}-injective modules.
